page.overview:
Who is Francesca?

Sister Francesca was a strong, intelligent and alluring member of the Bene Gesserit who left a lasting impression in her wake. Once a great love of Emperor Javicco Corrino, her return to the Imperial Opal Palace strained the balance of power in Corrinth City.

Francesca trained as an acolyte alongside Valya Harkonnen and Kasha Jinjo. When Dorotea singled Valya out as being uncommitted, Francesca and Kasha told her that wasn't fair. Then the time came for them to take their vows. They had to stand out in the rain until they were ready to put Sisterhood Above All. Francesca was one of the last to make this vow. When Dorotea and Valya's rivalry caused a division in the sisterhood, with everyone choosing a side, Valya told Francesca and Kasha that Raquella was going to name her the next Mother Superior. However, before she did that, she wanted them both to undergo the Agony test. Dorotea was ready for that, while Valya chose to run away.

After their Mother Superior Raquella, died, Valya said that Raquella had warned them that Tiran-Arafel was coming. Francesca, Tula, and Kasha watched as Valya used The Voice to order Dorotea, Raquella's granddaughter, to kill herself because Dorotea refused to follow Valya's wishes. Valya showed them the breeding index, which determined that Javicco Corrino and Natalya Arat would make the best match to provide offspring to benefit the Sisterhood. Since Natalya was still a child, Francesca was sent to keep Javicco occupied until she was ready to marry him, while Kasha was sent to be Javicco's Truthsayer and most trusted confidante. When Tula gave birth, she decided she couldn't allow her son to be part of Valya's plan, so she and Francesca swapped him with a stillborn infant and told Valya he'd died.

Francesca and Javicco's union later produced a son, Constantine.
